title: Korean Pokemon Stamie 121/165 Holo Rare Scarlet/Violet 151 NM/M
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Korean Pokemon Stamie card is a must-have for any serious collector. With a holographic finish and a rarity level of Holo Rare, this card is sure to be a standout addition to your collection. The card features Starmie, a beloved character from the Pokemon TCG, and is part of the Scarlet & Violet set.

The card is manufactured by Nintendo and is in excellent shape, with a Card Condition of Near Mint or Better. It is numbered 121/165 and is suitable for ages 13 and up. This card is perfect for any fan of the Pokemon franchise who is looking to add a rare and unique card to their collection.
